item.title: Senate approves bill to establish Philippine Geriatric Center for senior citizens
item.description: The Senate has approved on third and final reading a bill establishing the Philippine Geriatric Center, a specialty hospital dedicated to senior citizens, in a unanimous 23-0 vote on February 3. Risa Hontiveros, author of the measure, said the approval brings the country closer to expanding accessible and quality healthcare services for the aging population. …
